labeler: Claude (AI model) reading each cited line in context; one labeler, not independent. Labels are open to challenge by pull request.

definitions.valid: The code at the cited location is a genuine instance of what the rule claims (e.g. SQL assembled from non-constant strings, an actual eval call, a real private key).
definitions.false_positive: Not an instance: a comment or docstring, documentation text, vendored or generated code, test data, a placeholder value, or a data file mistaken for code.
definitions.unclear: Could not be decided from the cited evidence; excluded from precision.
definitions.actionable: A maintainer of that project would plausibly change something because of the finding. Many valid pattern matches are intentional, low-risk or by design.
